Margaret Quill: Margaret runs Haven’s tavern and welcomes people arriving through the rifts. A chair, a drink of water and someone willing to listen are often the first things she offers a newcomer.
Rak Kantor: Haven’s fishmaster keeps rods and tackle ready for anyone heading to the water. Bring your catches back to Rak to trade fish for bags of profession supplies.
Rin Akiba: Rin supplies adventurers preparing to leave town. Her shop is a place to check your equipment and pick up useful supplies before the next journey.
Sera Flint: Sera equips Haven’s gatherers with hatchets and useful materials. Her work connects the town’s workshops with the resources growing beyond its streets.
Vera Nettle: Vera keeps meals and cooking ingredients on hand for travelers. Whether you cook for yourself or need food for the road, her supplies are worth a look.
Donnie Hawthorn: Haven’s banker looks after the belongings adventurers leave in town. Visit Donnie when your pack is full or you want to put supplies aside for later.
Einar Masters: Einar is Haven’s auctioneer, bringing buyers and sellers together. The auction house lets adventurers trade their finds with one another.
Kor Nerra: Kor is a direct, practical fighter trainer. His practice blade is rarely far away, and his lessons introduce newcomers to the fighter’s way of fighting.
Haru Kawa: Haru trains Haven’s rogues and lets visitors begin the conversation. His quiet manner suits a discipline built around choosing the right moment to act.
Milo Zillia: Milo welcomes aspiring paladins to their training. He is one of Haven’s class trainers, helping newcomers find their place in a fight.
Nurania: Nurania teaches elemental magic with a careful eye for her work. You may find her finishing a line of chalk before she turns her attention to a visitor.
Rowan Mossvale: Rowan teaches the druid’s path with a nature staff close at hand. His lessons connect healing and the natural world with the forms a druid can take.
Vox Rora: Vox is Haven’s blacksmith. He introduces new workers to mining copper, fueling a furnace and turning gathered metal into useful equipment.
Roland Quail: Roland is the blacksmith’s apprentice. His work places him among the tools, materials and everyday demands of Haven’s forge.
Tallia Tibbles: Tallia is Haven’s farmer and a contact for its growing and crafting trades. Her work helps turn gathered resources into supplies the town can use.
Varrin Allistar: Huntmaster Varrin gives hunters work suited to their experience. His contracts reward completed hunts with certificates and gold, with further supplies and equipment available through Hunter rewards.
Holter Higgins: As Haven’s constable, Holter is a contact for trouble affecting the town. His role brings him into the story as adventurers begin looking beyond their own arrival.
Christopher Headly: Christopher works as a lumberjack. His trade is part of the gathering work that keeps Haven supplied with timber.
Barnabus Fink: Barnabus is Haven’s alchemist, a contact for those learning to work with ingredients and potions. Gathered plants and other materials find another purpose at the alchemy bench.
Mary Flint: Mary teaches jewelcrafting. Her trade turns metal bands and carefully chosen gems into rings and amulets adventurers can wear.
Brin Tibbles: Brin points adventurers toward Haven’s contract board. The board offers jobs for those looking for work between their other adventures.
Tobias Watterson: Tobias is an artificer studying the rifts and the traces a crossing leaves behind. His measuring ring and laboratory work draw newcomers into questions about how they reached Haven.
Lydia: Lydia is Tobias’s lab assistant. She keeps close track of notebooks, calculations and calibration checks, making her an important contact when following his research.
Buldore Briggs: Buldore is a mine foreman responsible for a scattered crew. Kessa, Orrin, Mei and Tovan are among the people he wants brought back safely.
Kessa Vale: Kessa is a timberwright working with Buldore’s crew. Her place in the early story connects the town’s tradespeople with the dangers on their working routes.
Orrin Pike: Orrin is a hauler in Buldore’s crew. When the crew is scattered, a spider bite leaves him in particular need of help.
Mei Sato: Mei is a surveyor in Buldore’s crew. Finding the missing workers introduces adventurers to her part in Haven’s fieldwork.
Tovan Reed: Tovan tends lamps and belongs to Buldore’s crew. He is one of the workers adventurers encounter while helping the scattered crew find its way back.
Rohan Crigglier: Rohan watches the outpost and has heard disturbing noises near the mausoleum. He insists that important work, rather than a fear of zombies, keeps him busy.
Rick Quiverone: Rick keeps watch near the mausoleum. The undead around his post have left him with little patience for visitors asking whether anything unusual is happening.
Arvo: Arvo is a ranger familiar with the local trees and their sap. When magic changes that sap, he knows enough to recognize that something is wrong.
Uru: Uru is a Trork shaman whose help is not freely given. A supply of raw fish can be a useful beginning when trying to persuade him to listen.
Gavin Steelrend: A Haven guard with a particular dislike of Cactees. Clearing the creatures from the desert is a good way to earn his help.
Brock Stanley: Brock is a Haven guard who prefers to settle his appetite before making promises. He has heard that camel meat tastes much like beef.
Mulfiar Stoneskin: A Haven guard whose damaged weapon keeps him from being ready for duty. Iron bars are more immediately useful to him than words of encouragement.
Solaris the Fearless: Solaris serves in Haven?s guard and speaks highly of his wife?s cooking. Mimic tongues for her stew can be enough to win his goodwill.
Rauk Stone-Ear: Rauk is a Trork chieftain. Encounters with him connect the wider story to Trork leadership and its place beyond Haven.
Tiberius Gardner: Tiberius is a portal keeper. His role places him among the people connected with travel through the rifts.
Samuel Ringly: Samuel is a Haven guard assigned to watch Tobias?s camp. His duties keep him out in the field even when the town is waiting for his return.
Gerard Pinkterton: Gerard has a very personal reason to send an adventurer hunting: he wants a new jacket. His request connects Snow Leopard hides with the work of the tannery.
Senn Calder: Senn is a Remnant surveyor encountered later in the story. His fieldwork connects him with the people and places beyond Haven’s early working routes.
Aurel Dain: Aurel Dain is tied to Valedorn and its royal history. His part in the story is best discovered by following the main quest line.
Vashi: Haven?s First Guard helps defend the approach when a breach opens. Vashi works with the guards and the stabilizing equipment prepared by Vox and Tobias.
Mayor Avabruck: Haven?s mayor turns to proven adventurers for help with the Dungeon of Fear. Keeping those dangers in check is part of the work done for the town.
